historyReviewBoundary: All 115 histories have author source checks. Final independent review covered metadata and numerical checks for all 115 classes, 12 deeper class targets and source-gap samples in seven classes. It did not independently verify every passage of every cited source.

history.name: Sulfonylureas

starting.description: Unexpected hypoglycaemia during treatment with a synthetic antibacterial sulfonamide supplied the clinical starting observation. Investigators then tested pancreatic dependence, inferred insulin secretion and developed the therapeutic class.

inspiration.description: A clinical effect of synthetic2254RP followed by pancreatic/insulin physiology. No naturally isolated molecular scaffold is needed for the approved observation-led interpretation.

steps.description: Clinical hypoglycaemic events during antibacterial2254RP treatment prompted investigation.
Physiological experiments showed pancreatic dependence and supported an insulin-secretory interpretation and therapeutic proposal.
Later carbutamide/tolbutamide observations and clinical development established the oral hypoglycaemic class; individual later analogues are outside scope.

design.description: The programme deliberately investigated mechanism and related structures after the clinical signal, then developed and evaluated therapeutic sulfonylureas. The initiating adverse effect was not an activity first designed from scratch.

circumstances.description: The clinical hypoglycaemia was unexpected; subsequent animal/physiological and therapeutic studies were deliberate.

limits: The precursor2254RP was a sulfonamide; do not silently call every early precursor a finished sulfonylurea.
Observation-led describes the clinical/biological starting effect despite synthetic chemistry. It does not assert a naturally isolated structural template.
This class-level record does not reconstruct every later analogue or decide day-level priority.
conflicts: The2021 reconstruction dates an early dog experiment to12June1942, while the2007 abstract gives13June1942. The causal chain is retained without a day-level priority claim.
gaps: Original1942 clinical reports and the1946 thesis were cited in the historical sources but not independently read. A verified direct original URL was not located in the retained work, so no original-account link is invented.
The2007 and1984 accounts were read at abstract extent only; the central historical chain rests on the full deposited2021 manuscript sections.

humanContributionInterpretation.summary: Hypoglycemia during antibacterial sulfonamide treatment prompted investigation of glucose-lowering therapy.
humanContributionInterpretation.scope: The original 1942 account was not directly verified in the accepted dossier; historical accounts and subsequent experiments support the link.
